entries.text: Backend responsibilities include routing, authentication, authorization, validation, business logic, persistence and API responses.
REST APIs commonly expose resources through URLs and HTTP methods and exchange JSON.
Authentication identifies a user; authorization determines what that user is allowed to do.
Never put private API keys or database credentials in frontend source code that is sent to browsers.
Environment variables are commonly used to keep server configuration and secrets outside source code.
Databases: relational databases use tables and relationships; document databases store document-like records.
SQL JOIN combines related rows; WHERE filters rows; GROUP BY aggregates; ORDER BY sorts results.
